# Side A 0.5.10
- No more endless "Reading...": every account now says what is wrong and offers the fix: Sign in again, Wake, or Couldn't connect with when it retries. - Codex logins that OpenAI revoked now ask you to sign in again instead of being treated as a rate limit. - Claude logins that expired from disuse are woken automatically during your working hours, or right away with Wake. - The Terminal prompt explains what it does: new claude commands run as the account you or Autopilot pick.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
